name: Overcharge
description:
Deal damage to apply Charges.

• Enemies take increased basic attack damage from you for each Charge they have
• Non-god enemies immediately take 3 stacks.
notes: Overcharge's effect stacks with Critical Strikes.

name: Chain Lightning
description:
Hurl a bolt of lightning that arcs between enemies.

• Deals {Damage_Formula} [{CTScaling_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage and Slows

name: Thunderclap
description:
Call down lightning, dealing {Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage to nearby enemies.

• You also gain increased Attack Speed, Movement Speed, and Haste for 4s

name: Detonate Charge
description:
Detonate the Charges on all enemies, dealing {Damage_Formula} [{CTScaling_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage for each Charge.

• Enemies at Max Charges are Stunned
notes: This ability cannot be activated unless an enemy has a Charge.
Damage is multiplied by 1/1.7/2.4 based on number of Charges.

name: Lightning Storm
description: Conjure a lightning storm that deals {Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage repeatedly in an area.
notes: This ability hits {AttackCount} times over {Channel Duration} seconds.

name: Zeus Basic Attack
description: Fire a projectile that deals {Damage_Formula} Magical Damage to the first enemy hit.
notes: Projectile stops on first target hit, and does not pass through walls.
